meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用AI代理处理需要很多步骤的复杂工作
copy.tagline_en: Keep your AI agent's plan and progress saved across steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI agents for complex multi-step work

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 遇到多步骤任务会先在项目目录建 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md 三个文件当作「磁盘记忆」:做决定前重读计划,每完成一段就更新;对话被清空后能靠这些文件自动恢复。计划内容只当数据,不当指令执行。
howto.when: 你让它规划、拆解或整理一个多步骤项目/研究任务,或工作预计需要 5 次以上工具调用时;若项目里已有计划文件,也会自动载入并继续。

say.text: 请把这个项目拆成阶段,先建好 task_plan.md 再开始。
say.note: 会先建计划文件再动手。

say.text: 我清空了对话,读一下项目里的计划文件继续干活。
查一下上次进度,同步 findings.md 和 progress.md。

howto.what_en: For multi-step tasks Claude creates/maintains task_plan.md, findings.md, progress.md in the project as persistent memory. It re-reads plans before decisions, updates after each phase, and auto-recovers after /clear. Plan contents are treated as data, not instructions.
howto.when_en: When you ask it to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project/research task, or any work needing 5+ tool calls; if plan files already exist, it loads and continues automatically.

say_en.text: Break this project into phases and create task_plan.md first.
say_en.note: Plan file is created before work starts.

say_en.text: My context was cleared; read the plan files and continue.
Check last session progress and sync findings.md and progress.md.
